ascend.comment: Ascending costs rolls: requirementBase rolls for the first ascension, multiplied by requirementGrowth for every one after. Ascending then burns your essence stash into Ascend Points (the upgrade tree currency): sqrt(essence / pointEssenceDiv), always at least 1 — the fatter the stash, the more points it converts to. Money is never touched by ascending.

upgrades.name: Fortune
upgrades.desc: +25% Luck per level. Luck multiplies the RNG — every aura rarer than 1 in your luck stays rollable, everything below it is filtered out.

upgrades.name: Multi Roll
upgrades.desc: +1 aura per roll. Rolls independently at full odds.

upgrades.name: Auto Roll
upgrades.desc: +1 auto-roll per second on top of the free one. Rolls even while the tab is in the background.
